sub_sector.value: Diagnostic imaging center management; upright MRI manufacturing

healthcare_segment.detail: Manages diagnostic imaging centers and multispecialty practices and manufactures upright, multi-position MRI scanners.

product_stage.detail: Upright multi-position MRI scanners are in use at diagnostic imaging locations.

therapeutic_area.detail: Weight-bearing imaging for back pain and spinal pathology, with whole-body MRI capability.
